sarah_pm: Quick sync — we're locking the GA acceptance matrix for inference pricing/ops. Need final calls on SLA tiers, docs scope, oncall coverage, and the telemetry gates. Who can own final numbers by EOD Friday?
lee_eng: I can own perf verification and the latency SLOs. Will run perf suite against 3 candidate quant profiles.
omar_sre: I can own observability and paging. Proposal: SLOs = 99.95% availability, p95 latency < 120ms for Tier 1; alert on error rate > 0.5% over 5m.
tasha_finops: I'll own pricing floor + pilot credits. Suggest a pilot price band and an overage protection for early adopters. Need estimates by Thursday for the contract team.
sarah_pm: @lee_eng @omar_sre @tasha_finops thanks — can you each add a short bullet to the GA doc with the decision and the test/metric you'll use to validate? Link: https://redwood.internal/ga/acceptance (placeholder) :memo:
lee_eng: Adding now. Perf plan: run 10k requests across seq lengths (32/256/1024). Validation script: `./tools/perf_run --profiles=3 --check=latency,p99,mem`. If p95 < 120ms and p99 < 450ms we pass.
omar_sre: Runbook stub in doc too. Quick snippet:
```
# On-call runbook
1) Detect: alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 150ms for 3m
2) Triage: check model variant, routing tier, cache hit rate
3) Mitigate: failover to smaller model; reduce batch size; route to dedicated pool
```
This will be included under "operability".
tasha_finops: Pricing note: propose pilot SKU with 20% introductory credit for first 30d, commit tiers for Dedicated with monthly minimums. I'll draft numbers and examples for 100k tok/mo and 10M tok/mo.
sarah_pm: On support: we need clarity on daytime vs 24/7 for GA. Suggest 24/7 on-call only for Tier 1 paying customers; daytime SLT for Tier 2. Thoughts?
lee_eng: Agreed. For Tier 1 we need a direct escalation path to runtime eng+SRE. I'll prepare a contact matrix.
omar_sre: We'll need a runbook drill before GA — 1h tabletop + one simulated degradation test next week. I'll schedule.
sarah_pm: Deploy constraints: if any of the core SLOs fail, hold GA. @deploy-bot are there any infra blockers for the week?
deploy-bot: scheduled-deploys: No infra blockers detected. Capacity check green for the selected pools. :white_check_mark:
sarah_pm: Great. Last ask — owners, deliverable, deadline? I'll capture and circulate after this thread.
lee_eng: Owner: lee_eng — perf verification, doc + script — due Thu 17:00 PT.
tasha_finops: Owner: tasha_finops — pricing examples + pilot SKU — due Thu 12:00 PT.
omar_sre: Owner: omar_sre — runbook + drill scheduling — due Fri 10:00 PT.
sarah_pm: I'll compile the GA acceptance checklist and send to execs Fri EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
